name: STIHL MSE 250
blurb: 120 V saw. 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on standard 3/8″ chain, .050″ gauge, 60, 66 and 72 drive links (33 RS3).
intro: The STIHL MSE 250 is the corded saw STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart groups with the MS 311 and MS 391. The chart lists standard 3/8″ pitch at .050″ gauge: 33 RS3 60 on 16″ (bar 3003 008 8913), 33 RS3 66 on 18″ (bar 3003 008 8917) and 33 RS3 72 on 20″ (bar 3003 008 8921). The specification table (catalog p. 66, as of 1 October 2024) calls it a 120 V saw and prints the chain type as “3/8″ RS3 or RM3” for 16–20″ bars. RM3 is a different cutter. This page does not add an RM3 loop, because the drive-link chart does not print one for this block. STIHL's file table lists 13/64″ (5.2 mm) for 3/8″ chain.
notice: The specification table also says RM3. The drive-link chart prints 33 RS3 only. Order the loop that matches the bar stamp.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 33 RS3 60 with recommended bar 3003 008 8913. The block header names the MS 311, MS 391 and MSE 250 together. Standard 3/8″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 16″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 13/64″ (5.2 mm) file for 3/8″ chain.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 33 RS3 66 with recommended bar 3003 008 8917. The block header names the MS 311, MS 391 and MSE 250 together. Standard 3/8″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 18″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 13/64″ (5.2 mm) file for 3/8″ chain.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 33 RS3 72 with recommended bar 3003 008 8921. The block header names the MS 311, MS 391 and MSE 250 together. Standard 3/8″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 20″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 13/64″ (5.2 mm) file for 3/8″ chain.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows
